summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (output assertion skipped on legacy consoles), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
